connector.name: cascade-img
connector.registryDescription: LLM-operable Midjourney pipeline: 21 MCP tools to compose, generate, curate with vision, and log.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package cascade-img. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the laffeyp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DISCORD_USER_TOKEN
env.description: Discord user-account token the bridge daemon uses to talk to Midjourney (captured from the Discord desktop app; see RUNBOOK.md).

env.name: MJ_CHANNEL_ID
env.description: Discord channel ID where the Midjourney bot runs.

env.name: MJ_IMAGINE_VERSION
env.description: Version token for Midjourney's /imagine slash command, captured from Discord.

env.name: CASCADE_BRIDGE_URL
env.description: URL of the running cascade-mj-bridge daemon that cascade-mcp forwards to.
